title: Vendorfiles Configuration
description: Configuration file for vendorfiles - a tool to pull files from GitHub repositories and URLs and keep them up to date

vendorFolder.description: Base folder where vendor files will be saved

singleLockfile.description: Write every dependency to one vendor-lock.json instead of one per dependency folder. true places it next to the config file; a string names the folder (relative to the config file, or absolute). {vendorFolder} expands to the base vendor folder

relaunchPrograms.description: Close a running program before its installer runs, and start it again after. Without it, a running program stops the install. An installer's own relaunch overrides this

vendorDependencies.description: Map of dependency names to their configuration

vendorDependencyBase.description: Base properties for vendor dependency configuration

repository.description: GitHub repository URL. Use url for anything else

url.description: Where a dependency that isn't on GitHub downloads from. Files reference it as {url}. It may hold {version} or {tag}

versionUrl.description: Where a url dependency's latest version comes from. A URL ending in .git gives the repository's newest tag. Any other URL is a page whose body, selected element, JSON value or regex match is the version. {url} expands to the url value, for a download that holds its own version. Without one, the dependency installs once

versionRegex.description: Picks the version out of what versionUrl returns: capture group 1, or the whole match. For a .git versionUrl or a versionJsonPointer list, only the versions it matches count. Use double escaping (\\d) in JSON

versionSelector.description: A CSS selector for the element of a versionUrl page that holds the version, as document.querySelector takes. The element's text is the version, or what versionRegex searches. End it with ::attr(name) to read an attribute instead

versionJsonPointer.description: A JSON pointer, with the leading / optional, to the value of a JSON versionUrl answer that holds the version. A string is read like a page. A list of versions gives the latest stable one, and a * segment gathers a value from every entry

version.description: Version to download. Can be a release tag (e.g., 'v1.0.0') or a commit hash for hash-based versioning

vendorFolder.description: Custom output folder for this dependency. Use {vendorFolder} to reference the base vendor folder

oneOf.description: Track a specific file's commit hash for versioning
When true, tracks the first declared file

hashVersionFile.description: Enable commit-based versioning. Set to a file path to track that file's commits, or true to track the first declared file

releaseRegex.description: Regular expression to filter which releases are considered when finding the latest version. Use double escaping (\\d) in JSON

locked.description: When true, prevents this dependency from being updated by 'vendor update'. Useful for pinning specific versions

alias.description: Other names for this dependency, usable wherever a command takes its name

vendorDependency.description: Configuration for a single vendor dependency

oneOf.description: A dependency downloaded from a url

defaultOptions.description: Default options that apply to all dependencies. Individual dependencies can override these values

installer.description: Run the one downloaded file as an installer instead of keeping it: `true` detects the type from the file, a type names it, and the object adds arguments and a scope. Windows only for now.

args.description: Extra arguments, passed after the silent switches exactly as written.

scope.description: Install for the current user only, or for every user of the machine (needs admin). Unset leaves it to the installer.

relaunch.description: Close the program if it is running, and start it again once the install ends. Unset follows vendorConfig.relaunchPrograms.

installerType.description: The installer technology: Nullsoft (NSIS), Inno Setup, Windows Installer, an MSIX package, or another executable that runs with exactly the given args.

filesArray.description: List of files to download from the repository or url

oneOf.description: Simple file path to download. A path ending in / takes a whole folder, and a path with * or ? is a glob pattern. Use {release}/ prefix for release assets, {version} for the version's numbers, {version:_} for them joined with _ (any joiner, or none) and {tag} for the whole version. For a url dependency, a name that is not a URL is where its url download is saved

File mapping object for renaming, moving, or extracting from archives. A folder or pattern maps to a destination: one ending in / keeps paths below the folder, anything else is a file name built from {path}, {filename}, {stem}, {ext}, {parent}, {version}, {version:<joiner>} and {tag}. A url dependency maps each URL, often {url}, to its output name. With no URL key, it maps members of the url download to names
Destination path for renaming or moving a file
List of files to extract from an archive

items.description: File to extract from the archive. A path ending in / takes a folder, and a path with * or ? is a glob pattern

oneOf.description: Map of files to extract from an archive with custom destination names. A folder or pattern maps to a destination, as in files
